_comment: Tier-2 for skfem time_dependent#6, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: ib.doflocs is the (ndim, N) coordinate array for initial-condition assignment; building the IC from mesh.p only matches DOFs for P1, and for P2 / ElementVector the extra DOFs are silently left at zero. Ran: a 4x4 MeshTri.init_tensor (25 vertices) with ElementTriP1 (N=25), ElementTriP2 (N=81) and ElementVector(ElementTriP1) (N=50); a direct assignment of a vertex-length array; a zero-padded assignment; ib.project; and evaluation on doflocs. Printed: doflocs is (2, N) for all three; for P1 it EQUALS mesh.p; for P2 the first 25 columns equal mesh.p and 56 DOFs are extra. A DIRECT assignment is loud -- ValueError 'could not broadcast input array from shape (25,) into shape (81,)'. The ZERO-PADDED form is the silent one: 65 of 81 DOFs stay at zero, no warning is emitted, and the field is wrong by 101% relative in the mass-matrix norm with a peak deviation of 0.9254. Evaluating the same callable on ib.doflocs gives an N-long vector within 0.28% of ib.project.
expect_in_output: could not broadcast input array from shape (25,) into shape (81,)
